issue.title: Finish gate-decision integrity landing gaps
issue.description: Close the residual contract, atomicity, notification-lifecycle, and requester acceptance gaps found while landing sase-zr.7.1.1.5, without repeating work that its three completed phases already delivered.

issue.description: atomic-lifecycle-completion: ratchet the published sase-core floor to the released gate-decision contract, delete the older-binding capability fallback, make receipt and attempt supersession atomic and correctly acceptance-scoped, preserve current post-response failures across plain replay, retain enough selection identity for every recovery command, and add the missing deterministic transition races.

issue.description: requester-recovery-acceptance: prove actionable failure recovery through launch approval, workflow HITL, plan approval, CLI and ACE; restore the specifically required plan archive and terminal-preparation recovery cases; and verify the integrated tree with focused, governed, and full checks.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Repair published sase-core-rs gate-decision floor — phase implementation removed the Python fallback and added validation, but PyPI currently has no files for 0.34.50; 0.34.48 is incomplete/stale and probe_core_floor reports it missing decide_gate_lifecycle, preventing a coherent pyproject.toml/uv.lock ratchet.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Repair pyscripts closer-dir lint for ACE TUI memory tests - just check fails in tools/pyscripts-260801 because tests under tests/ace/tui reference top-level tools/sase_bead while tests/ace/tui/tools exists.

Verified focused gate-decision lifecycle coverage: just test tests/test_gate_decision_acceptance.py tests/test_gate_executor_integrity.py passed; just test tests/test_validate_sase_core_rs_tool.py -k gate_decision_lifecycle_contract passed; installed local sase-core-rs 0.34.50 exposes required bindings. Required epic-symbol check had no entries. Full just check reached fmt, ruff, mypy, and feature-flag lint clean, then failed on unrelated tools/pyscripts-260801 closer-dir lint; recorded proposed follow-up on this phase. Published floor remains blocked because PyPI latest is 0.34.48 and probe_core_floor shows it rejects post_response_failure; existing proposed follow-up covers that release-floor repair.
